purpose: Teach: 元年/時空/界隈/特質/総称/現存/波長/即興

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業元年の理念を再確認しろ
lines.en: Remember why this company was founded. Review that founding principle.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative delivery. Each clause lands with clear weight. No rushing. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to and expects his words to be acted upon.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。グローバル時空を意識して動きます
lines.en: Understood. We'll stay attuned to that global vision in everything we do.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, not obsequious. Steady cadence. Shows he's already mentally shifting into execution mode. Slightly firmer tone than mere agreement—taking ownership.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本社界隈の地域貢献を進めろ
lines.en: And strengthen our community contributions around the headquarters area.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured. Slight pause after the opening—he's laying out another non-negotiable directive. Calm but expectant. Voice stays even, authoritative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の特質を明確に打ち出します
lines.en: Understood. We'll make our product's strengths very clear in how we present it.
lines.style: Nod in the voice—immediate receipt of instruction. Practical, no-nonsense tone. He's already thinking three steps ahead. Quick, clean delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の総称ブランドを目指せ
lines.en: Aim to become the industry standard. The name people think of first.
lines.style: Slight edge of ambition now. Not harsh, but the stakes are higher in this one. Lean forward slightly in the voice. Clear, direct phrasing. This is the goal that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。現存する伝統工芸との協業を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We're already in talks with established craftspeople. We'll move that forward.
lines.style: Confident, assured. He's already working this—just needed permission or clarity. Warm undertone beneath the professionalism. Shows initiative without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の波長を敏感に読め
lines.en: Read the market closely. Stay sensitive to what's shifting.
lines.style: Quiet intensity here. Not loud, but penetrating. Each word deliberate. He's touching on something he cares about—market awareness as a discipline. Slight lean-in quality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。即興のキャンペーンも柔軟に展開します
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep campaigns flexible, ready to pivot when the moment calls for it.
lines.style: Final confirmation—slightly warmer than before, showing he understands the full picture now. Steady, assured. The closer: shows he's absorbed the whole vision and knows how to move.
